 Follow Jackson 5 Member Marlon Jackson Reveals Stage 4 Cancer Diagnosis: ‘God Got Me’
 Brian Particelli Thu, November 19, 2026 at 6:24 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The Farah Shammas Podcast Marlon Jackson , one of the Jackson 5 and middle son of the Jackson family, revealed he's been battling stage 4 prostate cancer.
 The singer, 69, broke the news during an interview on The Farah Shammas Podcast published November 17, 2026 — after being asked by the host about his health and how he keeps so "fit and young."
 "I'ma break some news to you that you don't know. I'ma tell people right now, God has me, he already told me he has me," he shared. "I've had cancer for four years. Oh yes, but don't worry about it, God got me. Everything is great."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He then confirmed it was prostate cancer, before adding, "But I'm great, I'm good. Bad grass don't die, so I'm going to be around for a long time."
 ZUMAPRESS.com / MEGA
 Jackson explained that he's since had his prostate gland removed and also underwent radiation treatment, before again insisting, "Everything is fine, everything is great."
 He went on to thank everyone who has prayed for him, telling Shammas , "The Lord told me, cast your burdens on him and he'll take care of them and that's what he's done."
 "Even my doctor said, 'You're doing so much better than what I thought,'" the performer continued, adding that he cut sugar following his diagnosis and keeps up on his health by going on 4-mile walks four times a week.
 Advertisement Advertisement Marlon is the sixth child of Joseph and Katherine Jackson , born a year and a half before his brother Michael . His twin brother, Brandon , died shortly after their birth.
 He shares three children with wife Carol Ann Parker : daughter Valencia , 49, daughter Brittany , 48, and son Marlon Jackson Jr. , 45.
